explicit_validation.explanation: Paper validates LLM annotation accuracy against human annotations on a withheld test set (108 messages) using macro F1 score

prompts.notes: Prompt encodes grounding typology but exact text not shown in main paper; examples of grounding acts provided in Table

guidelines.notes: Paper defines grounding acts taxonomy with examples but full annotation guidelines not provided

sample_size.notes: Three authors annotated 10 dialogues (108 messages) from each dataset, used as withheld test set for validation

quantitative_scores.notes: Average across datasets; full table of results per label in Appendix E.1

validation_results.summary_finding: LLM annotator achieves reasonably high agreement (Macro F1=0.75) with human annotations on grounding act classification.

criteria_mapping.notes: Both LLM and human evaluators use the same grounding act classification criteria
